sentences.en: The front of the building, which is the most decorative elevation, has twin carved pilasters (Amo ).

sentences.en: Like AMO, it oxidizes propene to epoxypropane, but yields a racemic product.

sentences.en: To the strumming of guitars, In a hundred grubby bars I would whisper Te amo.

sentences.en: This page gives an overview of all articles in the 1911 Brittanica which are alphabetized under Alu to Amo.
